needs.GOOGLE_SEARCH_CONSOLE_CLIENT_ID: OAuth 2.0 desktop or web application client ID for a Google Cloud project with the Search Console API enabled
needs.GOOGLE_SEARCH_CONSOLE_CLIENT_SECRET: OAuth 2.0 client secret paired with the configured Search Console client ID
needs.GOOGLE_SEARCH_CONSOLE_REFRESH_TOKEN: OAuth 2.0 refresh token granted the Search Console read-only scope for the Google account
